title: Has the recent news of the “Drone” sightings been impacting your dreams ?
content: I’ve been following this since the beginning of December - for the last 4 nights I’ve been experiencing a reoccurring dream of me getting forced inside a spaceship (similar to boarding a plane) but right before I’m about to step on I start to resist and that’s when I wake up. Also, idk if this dream feels like mall world but it looks like it would be set on top the large hill and there are purple neon lights (similar to carnival lights) Has anyone else on this sub been having weird dreams outside of the typical mall world shenanigans?
